# POST /api/v1/user/emails

Add email addresses to the authenticated user

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-181`

**Headers:** `Authorization`

**Request Body** (`application/json`) — `CreateEmailOption`

| Field | Type | Required | Validation |
|-------|------|----------|------------|
| `emails` | []string | True | must not be empty array |

## Response

**201** — []*Email

| Field | Type | Description |
